BUCHITHEKE bugayiwe kubhuntsha umngcwabo eMpophomeni, ngaseHowick, ngempelasonto umndeni ungena ushaqa ibhokisi likamufi ngesikhathi kunenkonzo yomlindelo. Umndeni kaMnuz Bhekisisa Msane (62) waseShowe obehlala ekhweni kankosikazi omncane eMpophomeni ufike washaqa ibhokisi nesidumbu ngoMgqibelo ebusuku kulandela ukungaboni ngaso linye nomndeni kaNksz Sandile Ndlovu abehlala naye. UMsane bekumele afihlwe ngeSonto kodwa kugcine kungenzekanga abakubo sebelande isidumbu ekhweni. Umunye obekhona kwenzeka lokhu kodwa ongathandanga ukudalulwa uveze ukuthi uMsane unamakhosikazi amabili aziwa umndeni bese kuba khona noNksz Ndlovu owabhala ngasese naye umndeni ungazi. “Ubehlala ekhweni, kuthe esegula bamphindisela emakhosikazini akhe. Bekuthi uma esesindile bamlande ngoba kudliwa imali yakhe yempesheni nekhadi lokuhola belihlala kumkhwekazi wakhe. Intombi kuyaziwa ngisho endaweni ukuthi bese ikipitile namanje ushone uMsane ingekho izwe ngoba isishayelwa ucingo,” kusho umthombo. NgoMgqibelo ebusuku ngesikhathi kunomlindelo kuthiwa umndeni kamufi awuzange ukhulume lutho ungene waqonda ebhokisini kugcwele amakholwa ecula. “Ngibone sekushaywana, abebepheka baphuma nokudla kwathelwana ngakho. Amakholwa asale ecula, bathatha ibhokisi bahamba nalo kodwa nakhona bebelandelwa amatshe ngemuva. Abanye bahambe belimele nami ngithole imihuzuko,” kusho umthombo. UNkk Ntombi Msane oyilungu lomndeni kamufi uthe baphoqwe yisimo ngoba bebebona ukuthi uMsane uzongcwatshwa ezintabeni. “Ukuba ubenomuzi besizovuma amngcwabe. Sinqaba ngoba unamakhosikazi amabili asemthethweni futhi nekhaya elikhulu likhona lapho engangcwatshwa khona. Siqale emaphoyiseni eMpophomeni, sadlulela enduneni nasekhanseleni sayobika. Silufakile enkantolo udaba sayobika naseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya kwathiwa awukho emthethweni umshado wabo kodwa kuzothatha izinyanga ezimbili ukuthi usulwe. Sibone kukude kakhulu sayolanda isidumbu yize bebesithuka besishaya,” kusho uNkk Msane. Ethintwa uNksz Ndlovu uthe uMsane wamshada engasathandani namakhosikazi akhe. “Wagula wangena esibhedlela abantu bakubo bengamsizi waze wacela ukuthi sithuthe siyohlala ekhaya alungise nempesheni. Kuyiphutha ukuthi bengikipitile, ngiyasebenza ePinetown. Sebenzela ukudicilela igama lami phansi. Kuyimanje umzimba ubuhlungu ngitubekile ngoba kwase kuliwa. Noma bengimthanda umyeni wami kodwa sesithathe isinqumo sokubayeka nesidumbu. Sengigqoke inzilo yize ngingamngcwabanga umyeni wami,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu ekhihla isililo.

UBHOBOKA ngezinkinga zomrepha uZakwe, uphrojusa ophinde abe nguDJ we-hip hop, uNgane Sikobi othi ucasulwa wukuthi uZakwe akalikhulumi iqiniso ngoba efuna ukudatshukelwa ngenxa yokwehla kwezinga lakhe emculweni. Lokhu kuqhamuka ngemuva kokuba Isolezwe ngeSonto libhale ngoZakwe ophumele obala ngokuthi utshwala bucishe baqeda ikusasa lakhe emculweni ngenxa yezinkinga abebhekene nazo ngenxa yokuboshwa yinkampani abekuyona. Ungane uthe kungamanga aluhlaza ukuthi uZakwe uke waba nezinkinga emculweni waze wazinikela otshwaleni abebuthola ngokuphuziswa abangani. Inkinga kaZakwe ukuthi usegxekwa ngabantu abathi izinga lakhe lomculo selehlile njengoba ashiya iNative Rhythms ayefakwe yimina kuyona ngoba ngazana nomphathi wayo uSipho Sithole. Ngenxa yalokhu kugxekwa usefuna ukudatshukelwa kube sengathi ubehlukumezekile enkampanini kaSithole kube kungenjalo. Lezinto azishoyo ukuthi inkampani yambopha yindlela yokuzama ukungcolisa igama lami nelikaSithole okuyithina esimakhile emculweni. Ngisho ekhuluma kwabezindaba akawabali amagama ethu njengabantu abamsizile emculweni ngoba ulwa nathi, kusho uNgane. Uthe nokuthi ubesephila ngokuphuza utshwala abebuthengelwa ngabantu kungamanga aluhlaza. Kubangani bakhe uZakwe akekho obenemali ngaphandle kwakhe. Uyena obethengela abantu utshwala. Kukhona abanye engike ngixoxe nabo abangitshela ukuthi wabafaka nasezidakamizweni ngoba kunguyena obethenga yonke into uma enabo, kuqhuba uNgane. Ethintwa uZakwe ushaye ungqimphothwe ngokuthi ubenenkinga yokuboshwa yinkampani abekuyona. Engangizama ukukuchaza ukuthi ngibe nengcindezi sengiphumile enkampanini ngingazi ukuthi ikusasa lingiphatheleni emculweni. Okokuthi yimina obethengela abantu utshwala ngicabanga ukuthi naye uNgane akanalo iqiniso lalokho ngoba ubejwayele ukungifica nginezinsizwa ebesihlala nazo siphuza. Okusho ukuthi yena ubezitshela ukuthi yimina othenge utshwala, kusho uZakwe. Uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uNgane usenesilonda sokuthi washiya enkampanini usafisa abuye. Ngezinsolo zezidakamizwa, uthe ubengazi ukuthi isimo sesibi kangaka phakathi kwakhe noNgane ukuthi angaze athi ubethengela abantu izidakamizwa, athi akulona iqiniso. Odabeni olwedlule uZakwe uveze ukuthi izinkinga enkampanini iNative Rhythms zenze waze washiya nenkampani ayisungula noNgane, iSphethu Entertainment. Ungane uthe uZakwe wayengasayinile njengomculi kwiSphethu kodwa wayengumphathi. Uthe ngesikhathi ehamba wabhala incwadi esho ukuthi uyayiyeka inkampani ngoba uyabambezeleka emculweni okuyinto engahlangene nezinkinga athi ubenazo. Isolezwe ngeSonto linayo ikhophi yale ncwadi uNgane athi yabhalwa wuZakwe. UZakwe uvumile ukuthi washiya kungekho nkinga kwiSphethu Entertainment. UNkk Muhle Sibisi ofundisa emkhakheni wakwaHumanities e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN), uhlonishwe ngeYoung Linguist Award emcimbini weminyaka engu-20 we-International Congress of Linguists. Bekuqala ukuthi lo mcimbi ubanjelwe kuleli selokhu wasungulwa njengoba ububanjelwe eKapa. UNkk Sibisi ohola nohlelo lwezilimi kwiSchool of Arts, khona e-UKZN, uthe ukuhlabana kwakhe ngale ndondo kusho ukuthi uyabonakala umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu. “Umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu akuyona into yakuleli kuphela kodwa eyawo wonke amazwe. Ngisho abe-Unesco bayakukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwalezi zilimi. Ukuthola kwami le ndondo kusho ukuthi nowethu umkhankaso uyabonakala. Izilimi zethu zanyathelwa kakhulu ngenxa yomlando wobandlululo, okuyimanje sizama ukulungisa lowo monakalo.” Kusho yena. Uthe zonke izifundo ngisho ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kumele zifundwe ngezilimi zesintu. Uveze ukuthi e-UKZN sebeqalile ukusebenzisa amanye amatemu ezilimi zesintu abaqhamuke nawo. “Awukho umkhakha noma izifundo ezingeke zingafundeki ngezilimi zesintu. Uma sebefuna ukusigxeka laba abangafuni siqhakambise izilimi zethu, basishaya ngokuthi kunamatemu angeke asebenziseke kahle esiZulwini. Okuhle ukuthi ezinye izilimi ziyahambelana, kungabolekwa amagama ukwakha amanye amatemu. Awekho amagama angeke atholakele uma sizimisele, ngisho emkhakheni wezomthetho nowezesayensi.” Echaza. UNkk Sibisi osefundise iminyaka emine e-UKZN, kumanje wenza iPhD lapho enza khona ucwaningo ngezilimi zesintu. Ucwaninga ukuthi amatemu esiZulu aseqalile ukusetshenziswa kulesi sikhungo ayazisiza yini izitshudeni ukuthi ziqonde kangcono ezifundiswa kona ngolimi lwazo. Ukuthabana kwakhe ngendondo kunezelwe nayindlela alwethule kahle ngayo ucwaningo obeluhambisana nokukhuthaza izitshudeni zale nyuvesi ukuthi zihaye izinkondlo zisebenzisa amatemu emikhakha yemfundo ezikuyo. UNkk Sibisi ubonge umphathi wakhe uSolwazi Heike Tappe, athe nguye omkhuthazayo emsebenzini wakhe kulesi sikhungo. I-international Congress of Linguist yasungulwa ngo-1928 kanti izingcithabuchopho zezilimi zamazwe ahlukene ziyahlangana njalo eminyakeni eyisihlanu ukubhunga ngezokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi.

KUQWASHISWE abesifazane ukuthi basheshe bazibheke izimpawu zokhwantalala ezinganeni, ezingagcina ziholele ekutheni zizibulale. Solwazi Sma Magwaza, Clinical Psychologist e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uthi ukhwantalala seluyisifo esiyinkinga kakhulu kuleli futhi uma singanakiwe baningi abazophazamiseka ngokomqondo ngenxa yalo. Izifo ezithinta umqondo azinakwa kuleli, sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukubona ophazamiseke ngokomqondo emgwaqweni engasizwa. Ingane ingashaywa esikoleni kuthiwa ayizwa kanti inokhwantalala. Yingakho kumele kunakwe izinguquko emizweni yomuntu nasemicabangweni yakhe. Uma umuntu eseqala ukungathandi lutho, azibone engelutho kusuke sekuyinkinga. Ukugula ngomqondo okubizwa ngeBipolar kuqala ngokhwantalala olunganakiwe. Abesifazane bahlaselwa nawukhwantalala emuva kokubeletha, athe luphatha oyedwa kwabathathu. Ukulala kwabo emakilasini kuphazamise nokufunda njengoba kuthiwa othisha bagcine bengasafiki yavalwa ikolishi. Okhulumela isigungu sezitshudeni, uMbali Nxumalo, uthe bagcina ukufunda ngoMsombuluko odlule. Izitshudeni bezilokhu zibekezele kodwa inkinga iqale sezixoshwa ezindaweni zokuhlala ebeziqashe kuzona. Izitshudeni zizifakela izicelo ngqo kwaNsfas thina sithole uhla lwabazoxhaswa emuva kwesikhathi. Inkinga iqale ngokuthi kufike uhla lwamagama abazoxhaswa uNsfas ngesikhathi izitshudeni zisemaholidini ePhasika ngo-Ephreli 4. Bekumele ziqale ukufunda ngoMsombuluko odlule, ngenxa yokuhluleka ukubekezela zacasuka. Besisalindele ukuhlaziya uhla bese siluphindisela kwaNsfas ukuqinisekisa abazoxhaswa.

ITHOLAKALE ibulewe yaphonswa esimobeni esiseduze kwasemzini wayo ingoduso ebihlale ihlukunyezwa umnyeni wayo. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Nicholas Shangase uthe, washayelwa ucingo umkhwenyana wakwakhe ngeSonto ekuseni ebuza ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ayikaze ifike yini kubo ngoba iduke ngayizolo? Uthe ushiye amagwinya emafutheni waphuma akamazi ukuthi uyephi usebheke waze wadela, akamtholi. Uthe bafike isidumbu singakathathwa babona ukuthi uma usegcekeni izinyawo zikamufi ziyabonakala emobeni neduku lakhe lasekhanda beliwele khona. Iyangixaka le nto, kwenziwe yini ukuthi abasemzini womntanami bangamboni umuntu obesobala kangaka? Isidumbu sakhe kubonakala sengathi uqale washaywa, wase waklinywa futhi kubonakala sengathi uphonswe esimobeni eseshonile ngoba akukho okukhombisa ukuthi kuke kwashuduziswana. Uthe indodakazi yakhe nyakenye ike yalimala kanzima ishaywe umkhwenyana wayo. "Ubehlale eshaywa nguye umyeni wakhe kodwa ebekezele. Incazelo engitshelwa yona ngabasemzini nayo ayingenelisi. Bathi wayepheke amagwinya ngoMgqibelo ebusuku waphuma, wangasho ukuthi uyaphi wangabe esabuya. Bathi akekho ayexabene naye futhi akuzange kube khona ukuhilizisana noma ukulwa nomkhwenyana wakhe. AKUJWAYELEKILE ukuthi abantu abamnyama bakhombise ukuthandana ngisho sebeguga ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi ngabezinye izinhlanga abenza kanjalo.Kuhlukile kuNkk Thandi Ngonelo (65) nomyeni wakhe uMfundisi Eddie Ngonelo (66), abangabeluleki kwezomshado abangofakazi bokuthi uthando alugugi. Bangabaholi be-Act of Obedience Ministries eThekwini kodwa bayaziwa nakwezinye izifundazwe ngomsebenzi wokweluleka.Sixoxe ngokuthandana kwabo emuva kweminyaka ewu-40 beshadile. Bafike behamba ndawonye emotweni kushayela uMfundisi Ngonelo. Wehle ku­qala uNkk Ngonelo nengubo ephuzi, izicathulo ezisagolilde, wabopha ngomchilo ophuzi igoda eliyi-afro.Babukana emehlweni uma bexoxa bencikene.“Akukona ukuthi konke bekuhamba kahle emshadweni wethu. Indlela ebesixabana ngayo, kukaningi sibona ukuthi idivosi isifanele. Akukho nento etheni esasiyibanga kodwa sasibanga ngisho izinto ezincane,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Uthe bahlangana bengakasindiswa kodwa uNkk Ngonelo yena wayevele esonta.UNgonelo uthe enye yezinto ezazibaxabanisa wukuthi wayengafuni umkakhe asonte futhi babehlukene ngokwesikompilo.“Bekuthi njalo uma umkami ezoya esontweni ngimnqabele, aye ngenkani. Bekungicika nokuthi ubenezihlobo eziningi kanti mina ngikhule emndenini omncane. Kuyena bekumnandi ukuvakashelwa yinqwaba yezihlobo ekubeni kanti mina ngifuna sibe naye nezingane kuphela,” kusho uNgonelo.Bathe basizwa wukumenywa kwenye inkonzo yabashadile lapho bafike babona wonke amaphutha abo. Leyo nkonzo yalandelwa enye lapho bazinikela khona basindiswa.“Kuleyo nkonzo kwaba manzi amaduku sikhala. Kwabashadile ababekhona, yithina okwachithwa nathi isikhathi esiningi ngoba kwakonakele,” kusho uNgonelo.Yize bethe izinselelo aziphelanga emshadweni, bafunda ukubekezelelana nokukhulisana. Yilokhu abathi kuhlula abaningi kulezi zinsuku.“Inkinga wukuthi umuntu uqale ahlanyiswe isiqu somuntu bese egijimela umshado engakalazi ingaphakathi lakhe. Ngeke umthole umuntu ongenasici kodwa kumele uqale uzilungise wena. Kunezinto okumele ungazinaki ngoba ngeke uzishintshe. Umshado ukuze uqine kumele ube nezinselelo, ngale kwalokho akuwona umshado. Inkinga wukuthi abantu bajaha ukuphuma emshadweni bengakawazi,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Mayelana nokufundana okwaziwa nge-dating, uNkk Ngonelo uthe akunankinga ngisho kubazalwane. Okubalulekile ukugwema ukuya ocansini. Bebuzwa ngokwenza uthando lwabo lungafi, bavele bahleka babukana.“Engangikwenza ngifika emshadweni namanje ngisakwenza. Ngiyezwana nokuhlanzeka futhi ngiyazibambela ekhishini. Ngino-65 kodwa ngizizwa ngimusha kunalokho,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Banezingane ezintathu nabazukulu abayisithupha.Ezinye izeluleko zabo:*Musa ukugxeka owakwakho njalo uma kunezinkinga.*Uma usubazi ubuthaka bakhe, zama ukumsiza.*Ngeke umshintshe umuntu kodwa funda ukumbekezelela.*Hlala umuhle njengoba wawunjalo ningakashadi.*Thoba ekhaya ukhohlwe isikhundla onaso emsebenzini nasemphakathini.*Khumbulani ukuthi kunabantu ababukela kinina abafunda umshado wenu.*Ningazami impilo eniyibona kuthelevishini.*Ungasatshiswa wukuphumelela kowakwakho kodwa yazi ukuthi uphakamisa nelakho igama.

UNobhala walo uNksz Nobuhle Ngubane unqabile ukuphawula ngencwadi okuthiwa ithunyelwe esigungwini esiphezulu seqembu. Akafunanga ngisho ukukhuluma ngesikhalo okuthiwa basifakile uvele wavala ucingo. Umthombo opotshozele leli phephandaba, uthe abaningi bayesaba ukuphumela obala ngoba kuba sengathi bavukela iqembu. Umthombo uthi isigungu esiphezulu siyitholile incwadi evela kuleli ziko. “Awu kuyaziwa nje ukuthi izinto zihamba kanjani eqenjini abantu bakhalaza emakhoneni ngoba abaningi bayesaba. Uvele uthathwe njengomuntu ongahloniphi odicilela phansi iqembu uma uveza izikhalo,” kusho umthombo. Elinye ilungu elingathandanga ukuveza igama lalo lithi kufanele kukhethwe kabusha kulungiswe wonke amaphutha enzeka engqungqutheleni. “Kwakungena noma wubani lapha engqungqutheleni nezigqebhezana zokungena zakhwabaniswa. Wake wayibonaphi ingqungquthela eyenzelwa etendeni ngoba akhona amahholo oLundi. Baningi kakhulu abantu abangagculisekile ngendlela okuqhutshwa ngayo izingqungquthela ze-IFP,” kuchaza ilungu elikhathazekile. Lesi sikhalazo selama eduze esinye esavela ngosuku lokusongwa kwengqungquthela lapho indoda eyazethula ngoNgcobo isibongo, yasukuma yaphikisa imiphumela. Le ndoda ize yazibophezela ngokuthi izolulandela lolu daba kuze kube sekugcineni. Akuqali ukuthi kube nomsindo njengoba kuke kwabangwa imiphumela yokhetho lobuholi besifundazwe KwaZulu-Natal. Owayehola umkhankaso wezikhalo uMnuz Simphiwe Zungu wamiswa eqenjini emuva kwezinsukwana nje ephumele obala ngokungenami kwakhe. Okhulumela iqembu uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa ukuqinisekisile ukuthi incwadi ifikile futhi iyacutshungulwa indaba yayo kodwa wathi ngeke iphindwe ingqungquthela. “Sikholwa wukuthi kwahamba kahle konke engqungqutheleni yeqembu. INHLANGANO ebhekela abanesifo sokuhanjelwa wumqondo esibizwa nge-dementia, ifuna uhulumeni asifake ngaphansi kwezifo zokukhubazeka ukuze kusizakale abanaso. I-Bessie Makatini Foundation (BMF), iveze lokhu izolo esithangamini sokuqwashisa ngalesi sifo eThekwini. UMnuz Stan Chidavanzi ongomunye wabagqugquzeli bale nhlangano ozinze e-England, uthe kusenzima ukusiza abanalesi sifo ngoba nohulumeni akabaxhasi. Uthe ngisho izinhlangano ezisiza abaneDementia azilutholi uxhaso. Uveze ukuthi lesi sifo sesibulala abesifazane ukwedlula ezinye izifo e-England. Silwela ukuthi uhulumeni asithathe njengokukhubazeka lesi sifo ngoba sibucayi kakhulu. Inkinga esibhekene nayo wukuthi abantu abayazi i-dementia, abayiqondi futhi abafundisekile kahle ngayo. Kusanezinkolelo zokuthi onalesi sifo uyathakatha noma uthakathiwe. Enaba ngalesi sifo uthe kusuke kufe ama-brain cells.Uveze ukuthi onaso akawuboni umehluko phakathi kobusuku nemini, yingakho abanye bebanjwa bentwayiza emgwaqweni ngisho ebusuku. Ukhale ngokuthi lesi sifo aselapheki kodwa kunemishanguzo edambisa kuphela ukukhohlwa okwesikhashana. Yize lesi sifo kuthiwa sihlasela kakhulu izalukazi, uChidavanzi uthe siyenzeka nakulabo abasebasha. Uthe izidakamizwa nazo zinomthelela kulokhu. UNkk Madanda Mabizela ongumnakekeli wabanalesi sifo, uthe unina ongasekho wayenaso. Uthe uma unalesi sifo udinga ukugadwa ubusuku nemini. Ulinganise ngonina athe wake wazama ukuphuza upharafini. Kumele bahlale benakiwe, bangasitholi isikhathi eside sokuba bodwa. Kumele kungapheli amahora amabili onalesi sifo engakaze anyakaze. Kufanele bazivocavoce, ngisho elele umuntu ujwayele ukumelula umzimba. Uthe ukulala isikhathi eside kudala izilonda, ezingakubulala uma zinganakiwe. UNksz Shanice Moodley oyiSpeech Therapist, uthe abanalesi sifo kumele bakhunjuzwe njalo izikhathi osukwini. Uthe lokhu kubalekelela ekutheni kubuye umqondo ngoba bayakhohlwa. Ulinganise ngokuthi bakhonjiswe ikhalenda, bakhunjuzwe ngezinsuku ezibalulekile. Uma uma umuntu esesitejini sokugcina seDementia, akube kusasebenza lutho emzimbeni. Ababethamele lesi sithangami bakhale ngokuthi kudingeke bayeke ngisho umsebenzi ukuze bagade abanalesi sifo emakhaya. Kuvele ukuthi uma sebehanjelwe wumqondo bakhohlwa ngisho amagama abo. I-BMF yasungulwa nguNksz Bessie Makatini waseLamontville osezinze eLondon ngokusebenza. Naye washonelwa ngunina ngenxa yalesi sifo.

Njengoba ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke kubhaliselwe ukuvota okokugcina ngaphambi kokhetho oluzoba ngoMeyi, enye intsha ayikaqinisekisi ukuthi izobhalisa. Uthe uzoya kobhalisela ukuvota ngesonto elizayo kodwa usazibuza ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elifanelwe yivoti lakhe. Ukhale nangokuthi akayiboni intsha ebuholini bamaqembu ngisho ePhalamende kugcwele kakhulu abadala okwenza intsha ibone singekho isidingo sokubavotela. Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi umdlavuza awukhethi ngisho iminyaka. Sike saba nengane eneminyaka emibili etholakale inomdlavuza webele,” kuchaza uNkk Benecke. Uthe bayazama ukuqwashisa ngisho ezindaweni ezisemakhaya nasezikoleni. Ukhale ngokuthi abasebenzisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni bathatha isikhathi ukwelashwa ngenxa yokugcwala, yingakho behamba zonke izindawo ukuyohlolela umdlavuza. UNkk Dany Ribbink (42) ongomunye wabaphila nomdlavuza webele uxoxe ngobunzima abhekane nabo eqala ukuthola ngawo. Uthe waqala ukuhlinzwa ngoMashi enesigaxa ebeleni. Uveze ukuthi unina naye wathola ukuthi unomdlavuza eneminyaka engu-39. “Ngangisaba kakhulu emuva kwesonto ngihlinziwe ngoba kwaba noshintsho nasempilweni yami. Ukhuthaze abesifazane ukuthi bathole umbono wesibili kadokotela ukuqinisekisa isimo sempilo yabo. Uthe lokhu kusiza nangokuthi uzinike isikhathi sokwamukela, uthole nodokotela ozokwelapha ngendlela efanele.
